question: Explain how inventories are measured under AS 2 'Valuation of Inventories'. Which costs are included in, and excluded from, the cost of inventories?

points.label: Measurement basis
points.description: Inventories are measured at the lower of cost and net realisable value.
points.basis: AS 2, measurement of inventories at lower of cost and net realisable value

points.label: Cost of purchase
points.description: Purchase price, duties and taxes (other than those recoverable), freight inwards and handling, less trade discounts and rebates.

points.label: Cost of conversion
points.description: Direct costs plus a systematic allocation of fixed and variable production overheads; fixed overheads are allocated on the basis of normal capacity.
points.basis: AS 2, costs of conversion and allocation of fixed overheads on normal capacity

points.label: Costs excluded
points.description: Abnormal wastage, storage costs (unless necessary in production), administrative overheads that do not bring inventory to its present location and condition, and selling costs are excluded.
points.basis: AS 2, costs excluded from the cost of inventories

points.label: Net realisable value
points.description: Estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business less estimated costs of completion and costs to make the sale; write-downs are usually made item by item.
points.basis: AS 2, definition of net realisable value and item-by-item write-down
